  <require tools> cargo rustup sccache cmake ninja
  rustup target add aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
  <xtask> test --profile ci --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
    CFLAGS_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=-FI<root>/.config/windows/fdk-msvc-shim.h
    CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja
    CXXFLAGS_aarch64_pc_windows_msvc=-FI<root>/.config/windows/fdk-msvc-shim.h
    RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static
